parent_mobility.conclusion_used_for_neighborhood: no alternative atoms shared the exact input+root+joint-cell core; search therefore permits transfers across atoms only within an exact joint cell and rechecks all profile constraints

order: CM100 from CM100_atom only after RM100 independently passes readiness

profile.unique_count_gate: strict fractional relative error <=0.02 during search; this is conservative versus outward integer rounding at nonintegral endpoints

search.algorithm: deterministic greedy large-neighborhood over atom counts, using one-unit transfers within the same exact joint cell; accept only strict positive frozen-policy objective gain and a complete incremental profile pass
search.atom_member_policy: within each atom, materialize the top-k groups by the globally frozen Phase 2 integer priority, descending priority then lexical group_id; initial start bank must equal its atomwise top-k prefix
search.objective: maximize sum of frozen Phase 2 per-group integer priorities
search.joint_cell_scope: a donor and recipient atom must have identical six-field joint_cell tuples; no movement across cells

deterministic_neighborhood.donors: top atoms with selected mass ordered by ascending current last-selected priority, then atom SHA
deterministic_neighborhood.recipients: top atoms with unselected capacity ordered by descending current next-selected priority, then atom SHA
deterministic_neighborhood.pair_order: descending current objective gain, then ascending SHA256(seed|epoch|source_atom_id|destination_atom_id), then atom IDs
deterministic_neighborhood.checkpoint: write complete current ID manifest after each epoch and append progress events at least every 5000 pair evaluations

treatment.search_stop_proxy: supervised-signature multiset distance >= 0.12; final readiness uses exact D_train including capped invariance-pair context
treatment.if_proxy_or_final_gate_fails: do not authorize model contact; report bounded-search outcome

search.timeout_semantics: UNKNOWN_BOUNDED_SEARCH; never infer infeasibility or zero headroom

candidate_order: if and only if RM100 passes all readiness gates, search CM100
